title.zh: 项目总览与使用方式
title.en: Project overview and how to use this guide

summary.zh: 意义智能被定义为对其他智能活动的方向性调控。本项目把 V7.0 正典、研究系统、工程操作化与发布资产分开管理，避免把一个可运行原型误读为已经证实的理论。
summary.en: Meaning Intelligence is defined as the directional regulation of other intelligent activities. The project keeps the V7.0 canon, research system, engineering operationalization, and publication assets separate so that a runnable prototype is not mistaken for a confirmed theory.

zh: 阅读时先看版本与来源，再看证据状态，最后看工程行为。正典 V7.0 是理论来源；研究系统 v0.2.0 是当前公开实现；六层操作栈 v2.0 是 E0 工程扩展；白皮书 v1.1 是应用层摘要。四者不能互换版本号。
本指南的每个章节都可以独立阅读，也按“概念 → 证据 → 工程 → 运行 → 发布 → 验收”的顺序衔接。章节播放器提供独立的中英文合成旁白，字幕与文稿按音频片段生成，不借用旧有声读物的时间轴。
离线使用时请保留整个 project-guide 目录。HTML、脚本、图片、音频、字幕和下载文件都使用相对路径；不需要 CDN、字体服务、API 密钥或网络连接。
en: Read in this order: version and provenance, evidence status, then engineering behavior. Canon V7.0 is the theoretical source; research system v0.2.0 is the current public implementation; operational stack v2.0 is an E0 engineering extension; white paper v1.1 is an application-layer summary. Their version numbers are not interchangeable.

Each chapter stands alone, while the sequence moves from concept to evidence, engineering, execution, publishing, and acceptance. The player uses dedicated Chinese and English synthetic narration. Captions and transcripts are generated from the actual audio segments rather than borrowed from an older audiobook timeline.

Keep the complete project-guide directory when using it offline. HTML, scripts, figures, audio, captions, and downloads use relative paths. No CDN, font service, API key, or network connection is required.

zh: 先确认对象：正典、研究系统、工程栈还是发布资产。
先确认状态：已核验、工程草案、机制待核验还是人工待定。
需要可运行行为时，直接阅读智能体与只读 MCP 章节。
需要交付时，使用下载中心、构建脚本与验收报告。
en: Identify the object: canon, research system, engineering stack, or publication asset.
Identify the status: verified, engineering draft, mechanism pending, or human decision pending.
For runnable behavior, go directly to the agent and read-only MCP chapters.
For delivery, use the download center, build script, and verification report.

summary.zh: 正典 V7.0 的名称是《意义智能：意义文明的认知操作系统》。权威顺序为 KDP 定稿02中文 V7、英文校对母本、白皮书、MSI 配置、README 与 CHANGELOG。版本号只认 VERSION.yaml。
summary.en: Canon V7.0 is Meaning Intelligence: The Cognitive Operating System of Meaning Civilization. Authority runs from the KDP Final 02 Chinese V7 text to the English proof mother, white paper, MSI configuration, and finally README/CHANGELOG. VERSION.yaml is the only version source.

zh: 2026-11-26 的来源审计确认，KDP 定稿02与 V5 副本的 SHA-256 相同，都是 0fedff1ee5775bbc6812cea24f6024e36e54d43fac4776ba6f94c402ff4cb574；它们不是两个独立版本。英文母本 Meaning IntelligenceV7.docx 的记录哈希为 b4225b6371d0ea013fe2ae4db9ac396537e2bf30f94cbda5a2c342e5f570396b。
审计同时记录了上游未修问题：H5 表格单元格截断、H6 简表与卡片冲突、正典英文正文不完整、候选 DOCX 缺少内嵌图片并存在占位。项目没有静默修改正典，而是把冲突保留在审计记录中。
研究系统 v0.2.0 的 0.x 表示研究形成期。只有完成构念验证、首次预测性研究和独立复现后，才进入 1.0。操作栈 v2.0 与 MSI v2.1 各自演进，不能覆盖正典版本。
en: The 2026-11-26 provenance audit records the same SHA-256 for KDP Final 02 and the V5 archive copy: 0fedff1ee5775bbc6812cea24f6024e36e54d43fac4776ba6f94c402ff4cb574. They are not independent versions. The English proof mother, Meaning IntelligenceV7.docx, has recorded hash b4225b6371d0ea013fe2ae4db9ac396537e2bf30f94cbda5a2c342e5f570396b.

The audit also records unresolved upstream issues: a truncated H5 table cell, an H6 summary/card conflict, incomplete English body text, and candidate DOCX files without embedded images and with placeholders. The project did not silently edit the canon; it retained these conflicts in the audit.

Research system v0.2.0 uses 0.x to signal research formation. Version 1.0 requires construct validation, a first predictive study, and independent replication. Operational stack v2.0 and MSI v2.1 evolve separately and never replace the canon version.

title.zh: E0–E6：证据等级不是质量评分
title.en: E0–E6: evidence status is not a quality score

summary.zh: E0–E6 描述一个主张目前被检验到什么程度，而不是它有多好、多有用或多值得相信。V7.0 的 E3 是预注册假设加数据收集，E5 同时包括证伪与存活两个出口。
summary.en: E0–E6 describes how far a claim has been tested, not how good, useful, or believable it is. In V7.0, E3 means a preregistered hypothesis with data collection under way, and E5 has two exits: falsified or survived.

zh: E0 表示构念已定义，E1 表示已建立数学模型，E2 表示存在测量工具且信效度验证中，E3 表示预注册假设已进入数据收集，E4 表示独立实验室复现，E5 表示预注册证伪标准已受检验，E6 表示跨情境、跨文化、跨时间泛化。
旧项目文档曾把 E3 写成“在新数据上预测正确”、把 E6 写成“框架外领域独立确认”。这两条不是 V7.0 定义，已经废止。升级证据等级必须补上项目内可复核的证据链，不能靠改写措辞完成。
机制成熟度不能自动转移给工程操作化。例如认知负荷文献成熟，不等于 L1 组合已在本项目任务中达到 E4。六层栈本身仍是 E0；把它写成代码、画成动画或接入智能体都不会提高它的等级。
en: E0 means the construct is defined; E1 a mathematical model exists; E2 an instrument exists with reliability and validity under validation; E3 a preregistered hypothesis is in data collection; E4 independent-laboratory replication; E5 the preregistered falsification criterion has been tested; E6 generalization across contexts, cultures, and time.

Earlier project documents described E3 as correct prediction on new data and E6 as confirmation outside the framework. Those were not V7.0 definitions and are retired. Raising a level requires a reviewable project evidence chain, not a wording change.

Mechanism maturity does not transfer automatically to an engineering operationalization. Mature cognitive-load literature does not make the project's L1 package E4. The stack itself remains E0; code, animation, and agent integration do not raise it.

zh: E3 不是“预测已成功”。
E5 不是“很可靠”；被证伪也是有效成果。
证据等级与 claim status 是两套字段。
工程证伪草案须预注册后才能正式处置。
en: E3 does not mean prediction has succeeded.
E5 does not mean highly reliable; falsification is also a valid result.
Evidence level and claim status are separate fields.
Engineering falsification drafts require preregistration before formal disposition.

practice.zh: 为一条结论同时写出 evidence level、claim status、来源与失败条件；缺少任何一项时标记待核验。
practice.en: For one conclusion, write its evidence level, claim status, source, and failure condition. Mark it pending if any field is missing.

caption.en: Guide diagram: the seven V7.0 evidence definitions; levels are not quality percentages.

title.zh: 连续意义光谱与判断维度
title.en: The continuous meaning spectrum and judgment dimensions

eyebrow.en: 04 · Do not force it back into drawers

summary.zh: V7.0 第 8 章用连续光谱带取代固定的三层次。意义可以在抽象度与时间跨度上连续移动；方向、价值、边界是意义判断的三个分析维度，而不是三个固定层级。
summary.en: V7.0 Chapter 8 replaces fixed levels with a continuous spectrum band. Meaning can move continuously along abstraction and time horizon. Direction, value, and boundary are analytical dimensions of a meaning judgment, not three fixed levels.

zh: 早期离散模型的“元意义层”位于光谱抽象端，“情境意义层”位于具体端，中间没有断层。光谱模型目前仍是 MI-C004 的 E0 草案，需要用纵向数据检验连续分布，而不是先验地宣布它成立。
方向回答“朝哪里去”，价值回答“为何值得、对谁值得”，边界回答“范围、限制与停止条件”。MI-C003 提出这三个维度可用因子或结构方法检验；若单一维度解释超过 90% 方差，正典 H2 的失败条件触发。
不要混淆方向—价值—边界与系缚强度分析中的 C/V/E/A 四维度。前者是 §3.2 的意义判断维度，后者属于另一组构造。智能体只把光谱位置作为启发式标签，不把它当作心理测量结果。
en: In the earlier discrete model, the meta-meaning level sat at the abstract end and contextual meaning at the concrete end, with no gap. The spectrum model remains an E0 draft under MI-C004 and needs longitudinal tests of continuity rather than an a priori declaration.

Direction asks where to go; value asks why it is worthwhile and for whom; boundary asks about scope, limits, and stopping conditions. MI-C003 proposes factor or structural tests of these dimensions. If one dimension explains more than 90% of variance, the canon H2 failure condition is triggered.

Do not confuse direction–value–boundary with the C/V/E/A four-dimensional bonding-strength analysis. The former belongs to §3.2 meaning judgment; the latter is a different construct. The agent treats spectrum position only as a heuristic label, not a psychometric measurement.

zh: 连续光谱：抽象 ↔ 具体，长时距 ↔ 短时距。
判断维度：方向、价值、边界。
另一组四维：C/V/E/A，用于系缚强度分析。
光谱位置不是分数，也不是实证等级。
en: Continuous spectrum: abstract ↔ concrete, long horizon ↔ short horizon.
Judgment dimensions: direction, value, boundary.
A separate four-dimensional model: C/V/E/A for bonding strength.
Spectrum position is neither a score nor an evidence level.

practice.zh: 选择一个真实决策，分别写出方向、价值、边界，再指出它在光谱中的位置及理由；不要用“高/中/低”替代证据。
practice.en: For a real decision, write direction, value, and boundary separately, then place it on the spectrum with a reason. Do not substitute high/medium/low labels for evidence.

source.en: Canon §3.2 and §8.1; MI-C003 and MI-C004 in docs/claims.md.

alt.en: Continuous meaning spectrum and the direction, value, and boundary dimensions

caption.zh: 指南图解：连续光谱不是固定阶梯，三维度也不是 C/V/E/A 黏合强度维度。
caption.en: Guide diagram: the continuous spectrum is not a fixed ladder, and the three dimensions are not the separate C/V/E/A bonding-strength dimensions.

title.zh: 五个不可通约尺度与递归校准
title.en: Five incommensurable scales and recursive calibration

summary.zh: 个人、组织、城市、国家、人类五个尺度的意义不可通约。跨尺度协调不是加权求和，而是显式检查冲突、优先级、代价、触发条件与反馈。
summary.en: Meaning at the individual, organizational, city, national, and human scales is incommensurable. Cross-scale coordination is not weighted summation; it requires explicit conflicts, priorities, costs, triggers, and feedback.

zh: 公理三与 §4.3 禁止把异质价值换算成一个补偿性总分。一个尺度上的收益不能自动抵消另一个尺度上的伤害。智能体的 L5 因此输出冲突和优先级，而不是 weighted_score。
递归校准先保留各尺度的方向陈述，再检查两两冲突、优先级顺序、代价承担者和暂停触发器。若缺少输入，结果返回 needs_clarification，不用默认值编造。
跨尺度一致性相关 claim 仍处于研究状态。MI-C005 是 E1、Formalized；MI-C010 是 E1、Under Test。不能把“禁止加权求和”的工程规则误写成“跨尺度一致性已被证明能预测生存”。
en: Axiom 3 and §4.3 forbid converting heterogeneous values into one compensatory total. Gain at one scale does not automatically cancel harm at another. The agent's L5 therefore outputs conflicts and priorities, not a weighted_score.

Recursive calibration first preserves each scale's direction statement, then checks pairwise conflicts, priority order, who bears costs, and pause triggers. Missing input produces needs_clarification rather than invented defaults.

Claims about cross-scale consistency remain research-stage. MI-C005 is E1/Formalized; MI-C010 is E1/Under Test. The engineering rule against weighted summation must not be rewritten as proof that cross-scale consistency predicts survival.

zh: 五个尺度：个人、组织、城市、国家、人类。
不可通约：拒绝补偿性加总。
必要输出：冲突、优先级、代价、触发器。
缺失信息：显式待澄清。
en: Five scales: individual, organization, city, national, humanity.
Incommensurable: reject compensatory aggregation.
Required outputs: conflicts, priorities, costs, triggers.
Missing information: explicit clarification request.

practice.zh: 在一个组织决策中列出五个尺度的方向，至少写出一处真实冲突，并明确谁承担代价、什么信号触发暂停。
practice.en: List directions at all five scales for one organizational decision, identify at least one real conflict, and state who bears the cost and what signal triggers a pause.

source.en: Canon Axiom 3 and §4.3; MI-C005 and MI-C010; meaning_agent/constants.py.

alt.zh: 五个尺度之间的递归校准关系

caption.zh: 指南流程图：五尺度显式协调；不是可加权求分的金字塔。
caption.en: Guide flow: explicit coordination across five scales, not a weighted scoring pyramid.

title.zh: 正典机制与工程栈的映射
title.en: Mapping canon mechanisms to the engineering stack

eyebrow.en: 06 · A link is not an identity

summary.zh: 正典运行机制包括 M1 感知、M2 判断、M3 行动三个模块，以及 F1 意义识别、F2 意义评估、F3 意义决策、F4 意义反馈四个流程。六层栈是把这些机制转译为工程结构的待检验假设。
summary.en: Canon mechanisms include three modules—M1 perception, M2 judgment, M3 action—and four processes: F1 meaning identification, F2 meaning assessment, F3 meaning decision, F4 meaning feedback. The six-layer stack is a testable engineering translation, not the canon mechanism itself.

zh: L1 与 L2 主要落在 M1 的输入和呈现侧，并支持 F1；L3 与 L4 主要落在 M2 与 F2；L5 对应 M3 与 F3；L6 把 M1、M2、M3 重新串联并通过 F4 回写。这个映射用于解释工程意图，不用于授予证据等级。
界面带 L1–L2 处理“信息进不来”，加工带 L3–L4 处理“意义出不来”，元带 L5–L6 处理“方向守不住”。只有元带可以改写下层前提；L6 回写 L1 后形成螺旋，而不是一次性流水线。
架构文档特别区分 measured 与 planned 时间轴。MSI 渲染时 self.mark() 记录真实进入与退出时刻；缺少实测文件时，构建器才按配置推算并显示 planned。可体验不等于已验证。
en: L1 and L2 mainly sit on M1's input and presentation side and support F1; L3 and L4 mainly map to M2 and F2; L5 maps to M3 and F3; L6 reconnects M1–M3 and writes back through F4. This mapping explains engineering intent; it does not grant evidence status.

The interface band L1–L2 addresses information not getting in; processing L3–L4 addresses meaning not coming out; meta L5–L6 addresses direction not holding. Only the meta band can rewrite lower premises. L6's return to L1 creates a spiral, not a one-pass pipeline.

The architecture distinguishes measured from planned timelines. During rendering, self.mark() records actual act entry and exit. Only when measured data is absent does the builder extrapolate from configuration and label it planned. Experienceable is not the same as validated.

zh: 三模块：M1 感知、M2 判断、M3 行动。
四流程：F1 识别、F2 评估、F3 决策、F4 反馈。
六层映射：工程解释，不是正典层定义。
时间轴：优先实测，缺失时可见降级。
en: Three modules: M1 perception, M2 judgment, M3 action.
Four processes: F1 identification, F2 assessment, F3 decision, F4 feedback.
Six-layer mapping: engineering explanation, not canon layer definitions.
Timeline: measured first, visibly degraded when absent.

practice.zh: 追踪一个输出从 L1 到 L6，标明它经过哪些模块和流程，以及哪一步有权改写前提。
practice.en: Trace one output from L1 to L6, naming the modules and processes it crosses and the step allowed to rewrite premises.

alt.zh: 三模块四流程到六层工程栈的映射
alt.en: Mapping of three modules and four processes to six engineering layers

caption.zh: 指南流程图：正典机制与 E0 工程操作化的概念关联。
caption.en: Guide flow: conceptual links between canon mechanisms and E0 engineering operationalization.

title.zh: 六层工程栈：L1–L6 与三带
title.en: The six-layer engineering stack: L1–L6 and three bands

summary.zh: 六层栈是本项目提出的整合结构，证据等级 E0，未经独立检验。它由界面带、加工带、元带组成，每一层都有输入、输出、正典概念关联和待检验的工程边界。
summary.en: The six-layer stack is an integrative structure proposed by this project at E0 and has not been independently tested. It comprises interface, processing, and meta bands; each layer has inputs, outputs, canon links, and testable engineering boundaries.

zh: L1 减负把信息整理成结构；L2 可体验把结构变成可操作界面；L3 意义生成组织方向、价值、边界；L4 价值评估标注证据；L5 方向选择处理五尺度冲突；L6 反思与审视递归检查前提、触发复核并可逆归零。
各层的工程操作化状态并不相同：L1/L2 为框架 E1、机制待核验；L3 为 E0–E1；L4 工具 E2、模型 E1；L5 为 E1；L6 为 E2。这些标签只描述当前记录，不能把六层栈整体升级。
若更简洁且解释力更强的切分出现，应替换六层栈，而不是为它辩护。工程失败条件只处置对应操作化，不自动推翻正典 H 假设或外部机制。
en: L1 structures information; L2 turns structure into an operable interface; L3 organizes direction, value, and boundary; L4 labels evidence; L5 handles five-scale conflicts; L6 reviews premises, triggers revision, and supports reversible zeroing.

Layer statuses differ: L1/L2 are framework E1 with mechanisms pending; L3 is E0–E1; L4 tools are E2 and model E1; L5 is E1; L6 is E2. These labels describe current records and do not upgrade the stack as a whole.

If a simpler partition with greater explanatory power appears, replace the stack rather than defend it. An engineering failure condition disposes of its operationalization, not automatically of canon H hypotheses or external mechanisms.

zh: 界面带：L1 减负、L2 可体验。
加工带：L3 意义生成、L4 价值评估。
元带：L5 方向选择、L6 反思递归。
栈整体：E0；层标签不能相加。
en: Interface band: L1 load reduction, L2 experiential rendering.
Processing band: L3 meaning generation, L4 value assessment.
Meta band: L5 direction selection, L6 recursive review.
Stack as a whole: E0; layer labels cannot be added together.

practice.zh: 把当前工作流的每一步标到 L1–L6；没有对应层的一步明确标为外部流程，不要硬塞进六层。
practice.en: Map each step of a current workflow to L1–L6. Mark steps with no match as external processes rather than forcing them into the stack.

alt.en: Meta-intelligence six-layer stack and three bands

caption.zh: 指南插图：六层栈。它是 E0 工程扩展，不是 V7.0 正典固定层次。
caption.en: Guide illustration: the six-layer stack, an E0 engineering extension rather than a fixed V7.0 canon hierarchy.

title.zh: 六个智能体技能与注册契约
title.en: Six agent skills and the registry contract

summary.zh: meaning-agent 的 engine.py 编排六个确定性技能，skills/registry.py 是唯一注册入口。每个技能信封包含名称、描述、层、输入、输出、状态、待澄清信息和数据。
summary.en: meaning-agent's engine.py orchestrates six deterministic skills, with skills/registry.py as the sole registry. Each skill envelope includes name, description, layer, input, output, status, clarification needs, and data.

zh: 六个注册名依次是 reduce-cognitive-load、model-experiential-interface、map-direction-value-boundary、grade-evidence-falsification、calibrate-five-scales、recursive-review-zeroing。名称与层号必须在注册表、技能文档、测试和 MCP 目录中保持一致。
L1 保留未验证标记；L2 只生成本地显示建议；L3 不替人选择；L4 不自动认定实证状态；L5 禁止加权求和；L6 最多三轮递归审视，不删除数据或执行操作。
技能输出是结构化草稿，不是事实核查、心理测量、法律意见或安全认证。缺少材料时返回 needs_clarification；可选 LLM 只能提供未核验的语言建议，不能改变确定性技能、证据等级、尺度聚合或批准。
en: The registered names are reduce-cognitive-load, model-experiential-interface, map-direction-value-boundary, grade-evidence-falsification, calibrate-five-scales, and recursive-review-zeroing. Names and layer IDs must stay aligned across the registry, skill documents, tests, and MCP catalog.

L1 retains unverified markers; L2 only suggests local display behavior; L3 never chooses for a human; L4 never asserts empirical status; L5 forbids weighted summation; L6 allows at most three review passes and never deletes data or executes actions.

Skill outputs are structured drafts, not fact-checking, psychometrics, legal advice, or safety certification. Missing material produces needs_clarification. An optional LLM can only suggest unverified language; it cannot alter deterministic skills, evidence levels, scale aggregation, or approval.

zh: 唯一注册入口：skills/registry.py。
唯一编排入口：engine.py。
六份 SKILL.md：可复用的输入输出与边界契约。
输出必须可追溯到层、来源和限制。
en: Single registry entry: skills/registry.py.
Single orchestration entry: engine.py.
Six SKILL.md files: reusable input/output and boundary contracts.
Every output must trace to a layer, source, and limitation.

practice.zh: 在测试中遍历六个注册名，确认每层只运行一次、输出信封完整、待澄清信息不被默认值覆盖。
practice.en: In tests, iterate all six registered names and confirm each layer runs once, envelopes are complete, and clarification needs are not overwritten by defaults.

title.zh: 可运行智能体：安装、命令与输出
title.en: Runnable agent: setup, commands, and outputs

summary.zh: meaning-agent 只需要 Python 3.10+ 与标准库。无模型密钥时以 mode=offline 运行，输出六层结构、证据边界、证伪条件、待澄清信息与 approval.status=pending。
summary.en: meaning-agent needs only Python 3.10+ and the standard library. Without a model key it runs in mode=offline and returns six-layer structure, evidence boundaries, falsification conditions, clarification needs, and approval.status=pending.

zh: 解压 source-v0.2.0-release.zip 后进入 meaning-agent。最小分析命令是 python -m meaning_agent analyze --text "是否应该扩大试点？" --json。python -m meaning_agent demo 可运行内置示例，python -m meaning_agent serve --port 8766 启动仅回环地址的 Web UI。
Python API 提供 analyze、review、demo、to_markdown。review 接受反馈；当 action=replace_text 或 corrected_text 触发重分析时，原批准失效并回到 pending。结果中的 execution.performed 保持 false。
可选 LLM 只读取 MI_LLM_BASE_URL、MI_LLM_API_KEY、MI_LLM_MODEL。远程地址必须 HTTPS，超时 15 秒，响应上限 1 MiB，禁止重定向，要求严格 JSON 与字段白名单。不要把密钥写进命令、文档或输出。
en: After extracting source-v0.2.0-release.zip, enter meaning-agent. The minimal analysis command is python -m meaning_agent analyze --text "Should the pilot expand?" --json. python -m meaning_agent demo runs the built-in example; python -m meaning_agent serve --port 8766 starts a loopback-only Web UI.

The Python API exposes analyze, review, demo, and to_markdown. review accepts feedback; action=replace_text or corrected_text triggers reanalysis and returns an invalidated approval to pending. execution.performed remains false.

The optional LLM reads only MI_LLM_BASE_URL, MI_LLM_API_KEY, and MI_LLM_MODEL. Remote URLs require HTTPS, timeout is 15 seconds, responses are capped at 1 MiB, redirects are forbidden, and strict JSON plus field allowlists are required. Never place keys in commands, documents, or output.

zh: 依赖：Python 3.10+，无第三方运行依赖。
离线模式：mode=offline。
LLM 成功：mode=llm；失败回退：offline_fallback。
en: Requirement: Python 3.10+, no third-party runtime dependency.
Offline mode: mode=offline.
LLM success: mode=llm; fallback: offline_fallback.

commands: python -m meaning_agent analyze --text "Should the pilot expand?" --json

practice.zh: 在解压后的源码目录运行最小分析，确认 mode=offline、六个技能齐全、approval=pending、execution_authorized=false。
practice.en: In the extracted source directory, run the minimal analysis and confirm mode=offline, six skills, approval=pending, and execution_authorized=false.

title.zh: 人工批准门与不执行原则
title.en: Human approval gate and the no-execution rule

summary.zh: 任何影响外部系统的动作默认 approval.status=pending。批准只记录人工决定；approval.execution_authorized 始终为 false，工具不执行决策、命令或文件操作。
summary.en: Any action affecting an external system defaults to approval.status=pending. Approval records a human decision only; approval.execution_authorized is always false, and the tool executes no decisions, commands, or file operations.

zh: 批准记录包含 status、human_required、recorded_from、execution_authorized 和说明。默认 pending 来自系统默认值；approved 或 rejected 必须来自显式人工输入。状态变化不会把分析器变成执行器。
修订会使旧批准失效。review 检测到关键反馈、替换文本或 revision_required 时，revised_analysis.approval 回到 pending。这样避免“人批准了旧版本，系统却悄悄执行新版本”。
高风险领域应提示专业复核。递归审视不能证明无偏、真实或安全，也不能替代法律、医疗、心理、安全或组织治理判断。沉默不等于中立，异质伤害不能换算为共同分数。
en: The approval record contains status, human_required, recorded_from, execution_authorized, and a note. Default pending comes from the system; approved or rejected must come from explicit human input. A state change does not turn the analyzer into an executor.

Revision invalidates old approval. When review detects material feedback, replaced text, or revision_required, revised_analysis.approval returns to pending. This prevents approval of an old version from silently authorizing a new one.

High-risk domains call for professional review. Recursive review does not prove impartiality, truth, or safety and does not replace legal, medical, psychological, security, or governance judgment. Silence is not neutrality, and heterogeneous harms cannot be converted into one score.

zh: 默认：pending。
人工决定：approved 或 rejected。
执行授权：始终 false。
修订后：批准重置。
en: Default: pending.
Human decision: approved or rejected.
Execution authorization: always false.
After revision: approval resets.

practice.zh: 构造一次 approved 后再替换文本的 review，确认新结果回到 pending，并检查 execution.performed=false。
practice.en: Create a review from an approved analysis, replace the text, and confirm the new result returns to pending with execution.performed=false.

source.zh: meaning_agent/engine.py 的 approval_record 与 review；meaning_agent/safety.py。
source.en: approval_record and review in meaning_agent/engine.py; meaning_agent/safety.py.

title.zh: 只读 Web MCP 与本地 MCP 边界
title.en: Read-only Web MCP and local MCP boundaries

summary.zh: Web MCP 只暴露固定资源、只读分析和下载清单，不提供任意 URL、文件、命令或凭据访问。本地 Python MCP 与 Cloudflare Pages Function 是两个独立传输实现，协议版本和请求上限不同。
summary.en: Web MCP exposes only fixed resources, read-only analysis, and the download manifest. It offers no arbitrary URL, file, command, or credential access. The local Python MCP and Cloudflare Pages Function are separate transports with different protocol versions and body limits.

zh: Cloudflare Pages Function 使用 POST /api/mcp，协议版本 2025-03-26，请求体上限 32 KiB，默认每来源 IP 每分钟 60 次。公共绑定要求部署环境中的 MI_MCP_PUBLIC_TOKEN 至少 32 字符；MI_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS 是精确 Origin 白名单。

Web 工具包括 meaning_analyze、meaning_review、resource_catalog、evidence_levels、download_manifest。资源包括 mi://canon/v7、mi://evidence/e0-e6、mi://chapters/zh、mi://chapters/en、mi://skills/l1-l6、mi://downloads。URI 是虚拟标识，不映射文件路径。
本地 Python MCP 默认 127.0.0.1:8767，协议版本 2024-11-05，核心请求上限 512 KiB，公开传输策略也默认回环。非回环绑定必须强 token。两个实现都应保持只读；本指南未访问或读取任何凭据。
en: The Cloudflare Pages Function uses POST /api/mcp, protocol 2025-03-26, a 32 KiB body cap, and a default 60 requests per minute per source IP. Public binding requires MI_MCP_PUBLIC_TOKEN of at least 32 characters in deployment secrets; MI_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is an exact Origin allowlist.

Web tools include meaning_analyze, meaning_review, resource_catalog, evidence_levels, and download_manifest. Resources include mi://canon/v7, mi://evidence/e0-e6, mi://chapters/zh, mi://chapters/en, mi://skills/l1-l6, and mi://downloads. URIs are virtual identifiers, not filesystem paths.

The local Python MCP defaults to 127.0.0.1:8767, protocol 2024-11-05, and a 512 KiB core request cap; its public transport policy also defaults to loopback. Non-loopback binding requires a strong token. Both remain read-only. This guide did not access or read credentials.

zh: Web：POST /api/mcp；2025-03-26；32 KiB。
只读：固定资源、分析、复核、下载清单。
禁止：任意 URL、任意路径、shell、凭据读取。
en: Web: POST /api/mcp; 2025-03-26; 32 KiB.
Read-only: fixed resources, analysis, review, download manifest.
Forbidden: arbitrary URLs, paths, shell, credential reads.

zh: 八幕依次为信息洪流、文本降维、结构图、可操作界面、意义归位、证据着色、路径选择、递归螺旋。实测时间轴从 0 秒开始，最后一幕 32.600 秒进入，43.433 秒结束。

en: The eight acts are information overload, text reduction, structure diagram, operable interface, meaning placement, evidence rings, path selection, and recursive spiral. The measured timeline starts at zero, the final act enters at 32.600 seconds, and rendering ends at 43.433 seconds.

Evidence rings are visual illustrations, not real ratings. L3 uses nine points and the structure diagram uses two nodes. Counts come from msi/config.json and scene implementation, not old communication copy.

The source audit recorded a smaller publication-package MeaningIntelligenceScene.mp4 at 13.533 seconds, 854×480, 15 fps, and silent; the research-repository file with the same name is 43.433 seconds, 1920×1080, 60 fps, and silent. This guide bundles and plays the latter, with exact media facts in the manifest. That historical record does not replace current publication acceptance.

3：受控语言提炼的核心语句。
2：结构图节点；9：L3 示意点。
en: Eight acts; 43.433 seconds measured.
45: random overload fragments.
Three: core statements after controlled-language reduction.
Two: structural nodes; nine: L3 illustration points.

MI-C001 through MI-C012 cover definition, meta-layer relation, three dimensions, spectrum, multi-scale coordination, recursive review, and layer effects. New claims start at MI-C100; existing IDs are never renumbered, and withdrawn claims keep their IDs.

The white paper does not replace the canon. Theoretical citations return to canon sections, H1–H18, or Appendix D.7. title.zh: 发布、运维与变更顺序

summary.zh: 推荐发布顺序是修改源材料、重建媒体与文档、运行全套测试、校验包、人工浏览器验收、生成部署 ZIP、获得明确授权后部署、再做线上机器验收。未授权时不部署、不改共享域名、不写入凭据。
summary.en: The recommended order is: edit source material, rebuild media and documents, run tests, verify the package, perform human browser acceptance, build a deployment ZIP, deploy only with explicit authorization, then run online machine checks. Without authorization, do not deploy, alter shared domains, or write credentials.

zh: 本项目历史上的仪表盘拖 ZIP 曾出现“部署成功但资产不完整”。推荐使用 wrangler pages deploy，并确保 ZIP 根目录直接包含 index.html。部署 ZIP 必须与发布包文件集合一致。
内容更新必须从源开始：改字幕不能只改页面；改音频必须同步时间轴；改插图要同时更新中英目录和图注；改版本只能改 VERSION.yaml，再重建派生文件。
线上验收覆盖首页、收听页、下载中心、MCP、project-guide、音频、视频、字幕、EPUB、DOCX/PDF、PPTX、源码与完整 ZIP。自定义域名可能有人机验证；资源检查与真实浏览器检查要分开记录。
en: Dashboard ZIP uploads previously produced successful deployments with incomplete assets. Prefer wrangler pages deploy and ensure index.html is at the ZIP root. The deployment ZIP's member set must match the publication package.

Content changes start at source: caption edits cannot stop at the page; audio changes require timeline updates; figure changes require both language folders and captions; version changes start only in VERSION.yaml before rebuilding derivatives.

Online acceptance covers home, listening, downloads, MCP, project-guide, audio, video, captions, EPUB, DOCX/PDF, PPTX, source, and the full ZIP. A custom domain may require human verification; resource checks and real-browser checks must be recorded separately.

zh: 源 → 构建 → 测试 → 校验 → 人工验收。
ZIP 根目录：index.html，无外层文件夹。
部署：仅在明确授权后执行。
部署后：机器验收 + 浏览器验收 + 哈希复核。
en: Source → build → test → verify → human acceptance.
ZIP root: index.html with no enclosing folder.
Deploy only with explicit authorization.
After deployment: machine checks + browser checks + hash review.

practice.en: Before copying into the publication root, run only build and local acceptance. Leave deployment, domain, and token operations to the explicitly authorized release owner.

title.zh: 安全、隐私、版权与最小暴露
title.en: Security, privacy, licensing, and minimal exposure

summary.zh: 安全边界包括回环绑定、固定资源白名单、输入脱敏、请求体上限、严格 JSON、CSP、禁框、同源资源、认证、Origin 白名单与限流。任何公网暴露都需要额外评审。
summary.en: Security boundaries include loopback binding, fixed resource allowlists, input redaction, body caps, strict JSON, CSP, frame denial, same-origin assets, authentication, Origin allowlists, and rate limiting. Public exposure requires additional review.

zh: 本地 Web 强制 127.0.0.1 并校验 Host/Origin；静态资源固定白名单，无任意文件读取、路径参数、shell 或命令 API。输入与上下文遮盖常见密钥，错误信息脱敏，不保存分析、不记录访问日志。
公网 MCP 的 token 只存在部署环境密钥中，不能进入前端、日志、文档、manifest、测试快照或提交。Origin 使用精确白名单，不接受通配符；代理部署还要配置可信客户端识别与限流。
代码采用 MIT 许可，文档采用项目 LICENSE-DOCS。发布前确认音频、文稿、插图、PPT 与下载资产的发布权。页面应标明“有声解读 · 非书籍全文”和版权归属。
en: Local Web binds to 127.0.0.1 and validates Host/Origin; static assets use a fixed allowlist, with no arbitrary file read, path parameter, shell, or command API. Input and context redact common secrets, errors are sanitized, analyses are not stored, and access logs are disabled.

A public MCP token lives only in deployment secrets and must never enter frontend code, logs, documents, manifests, test snapshots, or commits. Origins use an exact allowlist, not a wildcard. Proxy deployments also need trusted client identification and rate limiting.

Code uses the MIT license and documentation uses the project's LICENSE-DOCS. Confirm publication rights for audio, scripts, figures, decks, and downloads before release. Pages should identify themselves as audio interpretations, not full book text, and state copyright ownership.

zh: 默认回环，默认只读，默认不保存。
凭据只进环境密钥，不进内容。
请求体、字段、路径、Origin、速率全部设限。
公网暴露前：TLS、认证、限流、人工批准。
en: Loopback, read-only, and no storage by default.
Credentials belong only in environment secrets, never content.
Limit bodies, fields, paths, origins, and request rates.
Before public exposure: TLS, authentication, rate limits, human approval.

practice.zh: 用虚构 token 做拒绝测试，确认错误响应不回显 token；检查前端、日志、manifest 与下载包均无真实凭据。
practice.en: Use a fictitious token for rejection tests and confirm errors never echo it. Inspect frontend code, logs, manifests, and downloads for real credentials.

title.zh: 自动验收、浏览器验收与接受标准
title.en: Automated checks, browser acceptance, and criteria

summary.zh: 验收必须同时覆盖文件存在、结构、哈希、媒体流、字幕时间轴、文档容器、双语切换、播放与下载。自动通过不等于人工无障碍、移动端或生产环境通过。
summary.en: Acceptance covers file presence, structure, hashes, media streams, caption timelines, document containers, language switching, playback, and downloads. An automated pass is not a human accessibility, mobile, or production pass.

zh: verify.py 会检查 18 章内容、36 个章节音频、72 个 SRT/VTT 文件、36 份文稿、图片与下载路径、manifest 哈希、媒体编码和时长、字幕单调时序、PDF/DOCX/EPUB/ZIP 容器、JavaScript 语法与浏览器自检。
浏览器自检在真实 Chrome/Edge 无头环境中切换中英文，检查正文、导航、图注、下载标签、音频源、track 语言、播放速度、进度、当前字幕、章节切换与外部网络请求。
人工验收仍需覆盖键盘顺序、焦点可见、屏幕阅读器、移动端宽度、打印版、Windows 高对比度、语音内容专业性、发布权与生产端点。未执行项在 verification.json 标为 pending；外部发布结果另见部署与在线验收报告。
en: verify.py checks 18 chapters, 36 chapter audio files, 72 SRT/VTT files, 36 transcripts, figure and download paths, manifest hashes, codecs and durations, monotonic caption timing, PDF/DOCX/EPUB/ZIP containers, JavaScript syntax, and browser self-tests.

Browser self-tests run in headless Chrome/Edge and switch languages while checking body text, navigation, captions, download labels, audio source, track language, speed, progress, current subtitle, chapter changes, and external network requests.

Human acceptance still covers keyboard order, visible focus, screen readers, mobile width, print output, Windows high contrast, narration quality, publication rights, and production endpoints. Unperformed items remain pending in verification.json; external release results are recorded in deployment and online acceptance reports.

zh: 自动：结构、媒体、哈希、字幕、容器、语法。
浏览器：切换、播放、进度、字幕、章节、离线。
人工：无障碍、移动端、内容、版权。
外部生产：URL、认证、限流与部署后资源，以在线验收报告为准。
en: Automated: structure, media, hashes, captions, containers, syntax.
Browser: switching, playback, progress, subtitles, chapters, offline.
Human: accessibility, mobile, content, rights.
External production: URLs, authentication, rate limits, and deployed resources, as evidenced by the online acceptance report.

practice.zh: 运行 python verify.py --browser，阅读 verification.json 的每项 detail；不要只把 summary.ok 当作完整验收。
practice.en: Run python verify.py --browser and inspect every detail in verification.json. Do not treat summary.ok alone as complete acceptance.

summary.zh: 本指南已完成本地构建与可自动验证的部分；正典上游修订、独立实证研究、人工无障碍与版权确认仍保持 pending。Git、Pages 与公共 MCP 的生产状态以外部部署和在线验收报告为准。
summary.en: This guide completes local build and automatically verifiable work. Canon upstream revisions, independent empirical studies, human accessibility, and rights confirmation remain pending. Production status for Git, Pages, and public MCP is established by external deployment and online acceptance reports.

zh: 维护内容从 content.json 开始；界面、章节、插图、技能、下载与旁白共用同一数据源。重建脚本只写入本目录，构建前需要指定包含发布资产的 source-root。
更新旁白后必须重新生成 MP3、SRT、VTT、文稿与 manifest；不要手工改时间轴。更新图片时保留中英两套来源与图注。更新下载后重新计算字节数和 SHA-256。
下一步优先级依次是：正典母工程修复、预注册验证、发布权确认、完整包验收、按已获授权执行部署、线上验收。Git 与 Pages 状态记录在外部报告中；每一步都记录负责人、日期与证据，不把 pending 写成 completed。
en: Maintenance starts in content.json; interface, chapters, figures, skills, downloads, and narration share one data source. The rebuild script writes only inside this directory and needs a source-root containing publication assets.

After narration changes, regenerate MP3, SRT, VTT, transcripts, and the manifest. Never edit timings by hand. Preserve both language sources and captions when changing figures. Recompute bytes and SHA-256 after download changes.

Priorities are: repair the canon master, preregister validation, confirm rights, run full-package acceptance, deploy under the existing authorization, then verify online. Git and Pages status are recorded in external reports. Record owner, date, and evidence for each step; never rewrite pending as completed.

zh: 已核验：本地文件、媒体事实、双语运行与哈希。
待定：正典母工程与独立实证等级。
待定：人工无障碍、移动端、专业旁白审听与发布权。
外部记录：Git、Pages、公共 MCP 配置与线上验收。
en: Verified: local files, media facts, bilingual runtime, hashes.
Pending: canon master and independent empirical levels.
Pending: human accessibility, mobile, expert narration review, and rights.
External records: Git, Pages, public MCP configuration, and online acceptance.

practice.zh: 把 pending 项分配给具体负责人和验收证据；只有证据存在时才更新状态。
practice.en: Assign each pending item an owner and acceptance evidence. Update status only when evidence exists.

source.en: docs/canon-audit.md; docs/roadmap.md; ROADMAP.md; verification.json in this directory.
